inlines.v: CHISEL, noun An instrument of iron or steel, used in carpentry, joinery, cabinet work, masonry, sculpture, etc., either for paring, hewing or gouging. Chisels are of different sizes and shapes, fitted for particular uses. CHISEL, verb transitive To cut, pare, gouge, or engrave with a chisel
